udder.meaning: mammary gland of bovids (cows and sheep and goats)

ulcer.meaning: an open sore on the skin or inside the body

ultra.meaning: (used of opinions and actions) far beyond the norm

umbra.meaning: a region of complete shadow resulting from total obstruction of light

uncle.meaning: the brother of your father or mother

under.meaning: located below or beneath something else
under.example: the under parts of a machine

unite.meaning: act in concert or unite in a common purpose or belief

unlit.example: the table was bare, the candles unlighted

until.meaning: up to the point in time or the event mentioned

unwed.meaning: of someone who has not been married

upset.meaning: unhappy or worried; to knock over
upset.example: she was upset by the news

urban.meaning: relating to or concerned with a city or densely populated area

usher.meaning: take (someone) to their seats, as in theaters or auditoriums
usher.example: The usher showed us to our seats

usual.meaning: occurring or encountered or experienced or observed frequently or in accordance with regular practice or procedure

usurp.meaning: seize and take control without authority and possibly with force

uvula.meaning: a small pendant fleshy lobe at the back of the soft palate
